experiment: EXP3 depth comparison FS vs SGBM on the same frames (CPU)
frames: snap0 of the 13 placements; physical left = right_rect.png (topic right), other = left_rect.png

sgbm.note: no tuning on these frames; parameters fixed before looking at any result

metrics: pad surface: pink annulus pixels (10..25 px from the clicked polyline, r6_perceive definition), robust quadratic fit Z=f(a,b) as in the day's perception; RMS residual (mm) for FS and SGBM; and the difference between the two fitted surfaces at the needle mask pixels (median signed, mm)

needle pixels (mask = band 5 px & darker than annulus by 18): fraction with valid SGBM disparity (hole rate), and median (Z_pixel - Z_surface_fit) for FS and SGBM: positive = pixel depth is nearer to the camera than the pad ... sign convention: Z_pixel - Z_surface; 'flattening' shows as a value near 0 relative to the true wire standoff; the expected true centreline is ~0.5 mm above the surface so values ~ -0.5 mm would be an unflattened needle
FS vs SGBM disagreement on the pad annulus: median |Z_FS - Z_SGBM| (mm)
limits: SGBM is classical and not tuned; no ground truth depth exists, so this only says which depth is internally more consistent on a plane and whether the wire is flattened by both; RAFT-Stereo is not installed -> skipped
